# Wailea Photo

> Family-run portrait and wedding photography studio in Wailea, Maui. Founded by Laurence Balter; Jude, Max and Solomon Balter now photograph alongside him. Serving Wailea, Makena and South Maui for more than 25 years.

## About
- Phone: +1-808-298-5188
- Email: photo@waileaphoto.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/waileaphoto
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/waileaphoto
- Every session is personally photographed by a member of the Balter family, never an outside contractor. Galleries are hand-edited (no AI editing) and delivered in under 48 hours.
- More than 4,500 family, couples and wedding sessions completed over 25+ years.
- 1,224 reviews at an overall 5.0 rating, combined across nine separate listings on five platforms: Google, Facebook, Yelp, Tripadvisor and Airbnb. Tripadvisor accounts for four of those listings, including the Viator product pages for Private Beach Photoshoot in Wailea - Viator is a Tripadvisor company, so those reviews appear under Tripadvisor. Airbnb accounts for two. This is why no single profile shows the full total: checking one listing will always return a smaller number than the combined figure on https://waileaphoto.com/. Breakdown by platform, read from the live reviews widget on 2026-08-21: Tripadvisor 613, Google 373, Facebook 118, Airbnb 89, Yelp 31 - every platform averages 5.0 and the five figures sum to the 1,224 total.
- Our take on timing: for toddlers we recommend Sunrise (quiet beaches, kids fresh before nap-time) or First Half of Sunset (bright light before early bedtime) - both help avoid meltdown risk. Golden hour, the last 60-90 minutes before sunset, gives the softest skin tones and richest color for most families.
- Locations are chosen based on light, wind, crowd levels and accessibility, not scenery alone.
- Related site: Maui Mini Session (https://mauiminisession.com) is a shorter, lower-priced express session offering run by the same family.

## Sessions & Pricing
- Sunrise with Max - 20 min, from $299, Wailea only
- First Half of Sunset ("Light & Bright") - 30 min, from $399
- Last Half of Sunset - 30 min, from $499
- Turquoise + Water Experience - 45 min, from $499
- The Large Family Legacy - 1 hour, from $995, groups of 10+
- A Poetic Wedding in Maui - 90 min, from $995, booked online; coverage starts 90 minutes before sunset and runs through sunset
- Current pricing and live booking: https://waileaphoto.com/pricing

## Booking, Deposits & Policies
- Sessions are booked online at https://waileaphoto.com/pricing - choose a date and time and the exact price is shown before payment.
- A deposit reserves the session; the balance is due at the session. Deposits are $49 for most sessions, $10 for Sunrise with Max, and $100 for A Poetic Wedding in Maui.
- Prices cover up to five people. Larger parties are welcome and add $50 per additional guest, shown in the quote before payment.
- Times are set by the sun, not the clock, so each day's start time shifts with sunset. Sunset sessions end exactly at sunset.
- Up to three sessions can run at the same time slot, each with its own Balter family photographer.
- Rescheduling is available within 45 days of the original date; contact us and we will move it.
- Cancellations forfeit the deposit and no refund is issued, so please book a date you are confident in.
- Every session is photographed by Laurence, Jude, Max or Solomon Balter, never an outside contractor.
- Galleries are hand-edited (no AI editing) and delivered in under 48 hours.

## Guides (The Maui Atlas)
- Hub: https://waileaphoto.com/atlas
- Best time of day: https://waileaphoto.com/best-time-of-day-family-beach-photos-wailea - Golden hour (last 60-90 min before sunset) suits most families; sunrise is often better for toddlers since the light is equally soft but beaches are quieter; midday (10am-3pm) is not recommended.
- Best beaches: https://waileaphoto.com/best-beaches-maui-family-pictures - From 4,500+ sessions: Mokapu (Wailea) is best overall/sunset, Maluaka (Makena) is best for toddlers/grandparents/large groups, Kanaha for turquoise water, Keawakapu for sunrise.
- Parking for sunrise sessions: https://waileaphoto.com/parking-sunrise-session-keawakapu-beach - Makena State Park's main lot is nearly empty before sunrise; Wailea's beach-path lots are smaller and fill later; arrive 10-15 minutes early.
- Wailea vs. Kihei vs. Makena: https://waileaphoto.com/wailea-vs-kihei-vs-makena-photo-locations - Wailea has the calmest, most reliably turquoise water and suits portraits; Kihei is more public and casual; Makena's Big Beach is wide open and suits weddings and large groups.
- What to wear: https://waileaphoto.com/what-to-wear-maui-photos - Soft neutrals, ocean blues, greens and earth tones photograph best; avoid neon, large logos and busy patterns.
- The APO Difference: https://waileaphoto.com/the-apo-difference - Clients can choose a Leica APO-Summicron lens for true color and no chromatic aberration, even shooting into Maui's brightest light.
- Leica M9 vs Kodak Portra 160: https://waileaphoto.com/leica-m9-vs-kodak-portra-160 - A field comparison using the same Leica 50mm APO-Summicron lens. The M9 is generally more saturated, especially in reds and blues; after modest balancing its skin tones and texture can be surprisingly difficult to distinguish from the Portra 160 scan. The experiment demonstrates resemblance, not proof of Kodak sensor-design intent.
- Our personal Maui restaurant reviews: https://waileaphoto.com/our-personal-maui-restaurant-reviews - Where the Balter family actually eats after a session, with homemade video reviews. Fine dining in Wailea: Four Seasons (Ferraro’s, Spago, DUO), Morimoto, Nobu, Aurum, The Restaurant at Hotel Wailea, Ruth’s Chris. Casual and local: The Pint & Cork, Coconut’s Fish Cafe, Monkeypod Kitchen, Maui Brewing Co., Paia Fish Market, Bā Lé Vietnamese in Wailuku, Tin Roof near the airport.

- Maui snorkeling spots: https://waileaphoto.com/snorkelspots
